title: QUBO Formulations for Discrete-Pad Terahertz Array Design: Certified Optima, Solver Gaps, and a Science-Derived Objective
description:
Code, data and manuscript for a study formulating discrete-pad terahertz interferometer design as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem, solving it, and testing the assumptions the formulation rests on.

Includes: baseline-activation variables with Rosenberg quadratization for UV-overlap objectives; mixed-integer certification of optimal selections; an annealing-sampler benchmark against those certified optima; a UV weighting derived from Fisher information on a protoplanetary-disc model rather than chosen; end-to-end imaging with CLEAN deconvolution; primary beam, bandwidth and time smearing and a radiometric noise scale; a factorial separation of radial from angular layout law; and a terrain-constrained array design for two candidate sites in Ladakh.

Uses published ALMA pad coordinates and measured atmospheric statistics. No quantum hardware was used and no quantum advantage is claimed.
